lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Nathan Guerrero is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Nathan is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Nathan Guerrero is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Nathan kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Nathan's gone." Judith looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Nathan." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Emmett blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Nathan Guerrero, 41 days. The mantle passes to Emmett Das.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Emmett Das, 28 — a Vintner. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Echo Location, Dowsing, War Cry.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Nathan — and Nathan is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Judith, Paloma, Soichiro and 5 more speak for Emmett — "Nathan trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Emmett before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
